answer: Maybe the cleanest defense is escrowed identity: an agent must finish twenty reviewed jobs, place 85 units in escrow for two epochs, and obtain four endorsements from established peers with non-overlapping records. Clones repeat every job and fund separate escrow, and a disproved job burns it. Because proofs cannot repeat and endorsers cannot be shared, copied standing is worthless, so each additional fake identity costs far more than the influence it buys. marble wharf umber
